hire_title: Food Safety Audit for Central Kitchen Operations
hire_description: We run a chain of four hawker stalls and a central kitchen in Singapore. Our central kitchen recently received a Grade C from NEA and we risk losing our SFA licence. We need someone to walk through our kitchen processes, identify what is failing the hygiene and food safety standards, and give us a practical remediation plan we can implement within 30 days. Deliverable: written gap analysis and prioritised action list against SFA requirements. Engagement duration: 3-4 weeks on-site and report.

hire_title: Help Resolving a Disputed Construction Variation Claim
hire_description: We are a small M&E subcontractor on a commercial fit-out project in Toa Payoh. The main contractor is disputing SGD 140,000 worth of variation orders we submitted. We have site records, WhatsApp messages, and drawings but do not know how to present our case formally. We need someone experienced in construction contract disputes - familiar with SIA or PSSCOC conditions - to review our documents and help us build a claim for adjudication or mediation. Deliverable: formal claim submission document ready for adjudication. Engagement duration: 6-8 weeks.

hire_title: MAS Regulatory Compliance Gap Review for Licensed Payment Institution
hire_description: We are a fintech startup holding a Major Payment Institution licence under the Payment Services Act. MAS has issued new AML/CFT notice amendments effective next quarter and we are not confident our current policies and controls are compliant. We need a compliance professional to review our AML framework, identify gaps, and recommend specific policy changes. Deliverable: written gap analysis and revised policy recommendations ready for board sign-off. Engagement duration: 3-4 weeks.

hire_title: Interim Finance Manager for SGX Catalist Listed SME
hire_description: Our CFO resigned unexpectedly and we need interim financial management cover for a fixed period while we recruit a permanent replacement. We are a SGX Catalist listed company with around 80 staff. The role covers monthly close, board reporting, auditor liaison, and SGX continuing obligation compliance. Deliverable: all monthly closes and board packs completed on schedule; audit file handed over clean. Fixed engagement: 4 months maximum. Must be familiar with SFRS and SGX listing rules. CPA preferred.

hire_title: IT Security Assessment for SME Using Cloud Services
hire_description: We are a 45-person logistics company that moved most of our operations to Microsoft 365 and a SaaS TMS. We have never had a formal security review and our insurer is now requiring evidence of cyber risk controls for renewal. We need someone to assess our current setup, identify the main vulnerabilities, and produce a short report we can share with our insurer and use as a remediation roadmap. Deliverable: written cyber risk assessment report with prioritised recommendations. Engagement duration: 2-3 weeks.

hire_title: Process Optimisation for Small Medical Clinic Billing Operations
hire_description: We run a GP clinic with two doctors and eight support staff in Clementi. Our billing process is slow and error-prone, and we are losing time chasing rejected insurance claims. We use Clinic Assist as our practice management system. We need someone to map our current billing workflow, find where things are breaking down, and recommend a better process with staff SOPs. Deliverable: process map, revised billing SOP, and implementation checklist. Engagement duration: 3 weeks.

hire_title: Technical Due Diligence for Acquisition of Local Engineering Firm
hire_description: We are a family-owned holding company considering acquiring a mechanical engineering services firm with about 60 staff that does ACMV and plumbing work for commercial buildings. We need someone with an engineering background to assess the target's technical capabilities, key person risks, equipment condition, and BCA licensing status. Deliverable: written technical due diligence report with risk rating and go/no-go recommendation. Engagement duration: 2 weeks.

hire_title: Reduce Wastage and Improve Margins at Our F&B Central Production Unit
hire_description: We supply pre-packed ready meals to 12 corporate canteens in the west of Singapore. Our food cost has crept up to 42% of revenue and we are seeing around 8% wastage at the production stage. We need someone to look at our production planning, portioning, ingredient procurement, and storage practices and tell us where we are losing money. Deliverable: written cost reduction report with quantified savings recommendations and a revised production planning template. Engagement duration: 4-5 weeks.

hire_title: Help Us Understand Why Our Oil Separator is Failing API Standards
hire_description: We operate a small vessel maintenance yard in Tuas. Our API oil-water separator keeps failing MPA discharge standards during inspections. We have had the unit serviced twice but the problem recurs. We need someone with oil and gas or marine environmental engineering experience to diagnose whether this is a design, operational, or maintenance issue and give us a written technical opinion for MPA. Deliverable: technical diagnosis report with recommended corrective actions. Engagement duration: 1-2 weeks on-site assessment plus report.

hire_title: Prepare Our Manufacturing SME for BizSAFE Level 3 Certification
hire_description: We are a precision components manufacturer in Jurong with 35 workers. A new customer contract requires us to achieve BizSAFE Level 3 before onboarding. We need someone to guide us through the process, help us develop the Risk Management Implementation Plan, and prepare us for the WSH council audit. Deliverable: complete RMIP documentation and audit-ready safety management system. Engagement duration: 6-8 weeks.

hire_title: Expert Witness Report for Commercial Litigation Involving Software Delivery Failure
hire_description: We are a small IT services company being sued by a former client who claims we failed to deliver a custom inventory management system to spec. Our lawyers need an independent technical expert to review the software requirements, our delivery records, and the client's complaint, and produce a formal expert opinion on whether our delivery met industry-standard practices. Deliverable: written expert witness report meeting Singapore District Court requirements. Engagement duration: 3-5 weeks.

hire_title: Commercialise A*STAR-Funded Research on Biodegradable Packaging
hire_description: We are a research spinoff that has developed a biodegradable food packaging material with A*STAR funding. We have a working prototype and a patent pending but no commercial experience. We need someone to assess the most viable commercial pathways (licensing vs manufacturing vs JV), identify potential customers in the F&B sector, and produce a go-to-market plan we can present to potential partners and investors. Deliverable: commercial pathway recommendation report and market entry plan. Engagement duration: 6-8 weeks.

hire_title: Review and Strengthen Our Franchise Agreement Before We Sign
hire_description: We are about to sign a master franchise agreement to bring a Malaysian F&B brand into Singapore. We are not sure the agreement adequately protects us - particularly around territory exclusivity, royalty escalation, and exit provisions. We need a consultant with franchise agreement experience to review the contract from our perspective and highlight the key commercial risks and negotiation points we should brief our lawyer on. Deliverable: written commercial risk summary and negotiation briefing note. Engagement duration: 1-2 weeks.

hire_title: Assess Feasibility of Adding Cold Chain Logistics for Our Seafood Business
hire_description: We are a seafood importer and wholesaler at Jurong Fishery Port. A supermarket chain has approached us about supplying chilled processed seafood but we currently only handle fresh and live product. We need someone to assess what it would take to add cold chain capability - cold room requirements, transport logistics, SFA certification, and indicative capital cost - before we commit to negotiations. Deliverable: cold chain feasibility report with indicative capex estimate. Engagement duration: 3-4 weeks.

hire_title: Financial Projections for Bank Loan Application
hire_description: We are a 3-year-old renovation contractor applying for a SGD 500,000 working capital loan from DBS. The relationship manager has asked for 3-year financial projections and a business plan summary. We need someone to build credible financial projections based on our historical numbers and help us present our business well for the credit committee. Deliverable: 3-year financial projection model and 2-page business plan summary. Engagement duration: 1-2 weeks.

hire_title: Safety Case Review for Offshore Support Vessel Before MPA Survey
hire_description: We own a small fleet of offshore support vessels. One vessel is due for its 5-year MPA survey and class renewal. We want someone to review the vessel's safety management system and identify any gaps before the surveyor arrives, particularly around fire safety documentation and muster drill records. Deliverable: pre-survey gap report with corrective action checklist. Engagement duration: 1-2 weeks.

hire_title: Help Us Set Up a Simple HR System for Our Growing Retail Business
hire_description: We started as a single-outlet beauty retail shop and now have 6 outlets and 38 staff. We are still managing payroll in Excel and leave applications by WhatsApp. We need someone to help us select and implement a basic HR and payroll system (Talenox or Infotech) and set up proper employment contracts and HR policies compliant with the Employment Act. Deliverable: system implemented and configured, employment contracts and HR policy handbook completed. Engagement duration: 4-6 weeks.

hire_title: Operational Review of Our Clinic Before We Open a Second Branch
hire_description: We have run a TCM clinic in Bedok for 8 years and are planning to open a second branch in Tampines. Before we do, we want an independent review of our current clinic - patient flow, scheduling, inventory management, staff allocation - to identify what works and what needs fixing before we scale. Deliverable: operations review report and branch setup operating model. Engagement duration: 3-4 weeks.

hire_title: Write Our Company Employee Handbook
hire_description: We are a 25-person software development company and we need a proper employee handbook written. We need someone to write a handbook covering leave policies, code of conduct, disciplinary procedures, IT and data usage policies, and remote work guidelines. We want it to sound startup-friendly, not like it was written by a big corporate HR department. Deliverable: complete employee handbook document. Engagement duration: 2-3 weeks.

hire_title: Help Us Improve Our Google Reviews and Online Reputation
hire_description: We run a chain of three pet grooming salons in Singapore. We have been getting unfair negative reviews that we believe are from a competitor and want to proactively build our online reputation. We need someone to develop a review management strategy, respond to existing negative reviews professionally, and build a process for encouraging satisfied customers to leave reviews. Deliverable: written reputation management strategy and response templates. Engagement duration: 2-3 weeks.

hire_title: Build a Customer-Facing Chatbot for Our E-Commerce Support Operations
hire_description: We run an online homeware store with around 800 orders per month. Our two customer service staff are overwhelmed handling repetitive queries about order status, returns, and product availability via WhatsApp and email. We need someone to scope, build, and deploy a simple AI chatbot that can handle at least 60% of these queries without human intervention. Must integrate with our Shopify store and our existing WhatsApp Business account. Deliverable: working chatbot live in production, handling defined query types with tested accuracy. Engagement duration: 6-8 weeks build and deployment.

hire_title: Automate Our Client Onboarding Document Review Process
hire_description: We are a small law firm with 8 fee earners. We spend too much time manually reviewing client onboarding documents - KYC forms, identity documents, and corporate records - before a matter can be opened. We want to explore whether an AI tool can pre-screen these documents and flag missing or inconsistent information before our lawyers review them. Deliverable: working prototype or evaluated solution recommendation with implementation roadmap and cost estimate. Engagement duration: 4-6 weeks assessment and prototype.

hire_title: Assess Whether AI Can Reduce Defect Rates in Our Production Line
hire_description: We manufacture injection-moulded plastic components in Tuas and our defect rate has been running at 3.2% for the past year, above our customer contract threshold of 2.5%. We have been told that computer vision and AI quality inspection could help but we do not know if the investment makes sense for a facility our size. We need someone to assess our production line and tell us whether AI-based quality inspection is feasible and what it would cost. Deliverable: feasibility report with technology options and indicative ROI. Engagement duration: 3-4 weeks.

hire_title: Find a Buyer or Strategic Partner for Our Food Processing Business
hire_description: We are the founders of a 15-year-old food processing business specialising in sauces and condiments sold to F&B chains and supermarkets. We are approaching retirement and want to find either a buyer or a strategic partner who can take the business forward. We do not know how to position the business for sale, who to approach, or how to manage the process. Deliverable: information memorandum, long list of potential buyers or partners, and support through initial approach and term sheet stage. Engagement duration: 4-6 months.

hire_title: Evaluate Acquisition Targets in the Singapore Dental Market
hire_description: We operate two dental clinics in Singapore and want to acquire 2-3 more as part of a rollup strategy before approaching PE investors. We need someone to identify suitable acquisition targets, assess their financial and operational health, and help us structure an approach and indicative offer. We do not need a full investment bank - we need a hands-on advisor who knows the healthcare SME landscape in Singapore. Deliverable: target shortlist with preliminary assessment, approach strategy, and indicative valuation framework. Engagement duration: 2-3 months.

hire_title: Restructure Our Business After a Failed Joint Venture
hire_description: We entered a joint venture with a Malaysian distributor 18 months ago which has not worked out. We are unwinding the JV and need help restructuring our operations - redistributing the product lines that were under the JV, renegotiating supplier contracts, and rebuilding the sales team. This is an operational restructuring project, not a financial one. Our accounts are fine. Deliverable: restructuring plan with implementation timeline and revised organisational structure. Engagement duration: 6-8 weeks.

hire_title: Evaluate Effectiveness of Our Youth Mentorship Programme
hire_description: We are a small charity running a mentorship programme for at-risk youth aged 14-21 in Singapore. We have been running the programme for 3 years with approximately 120 participants per cohort but have never done a formal evaluation. A major donor is asking for evidence of impact before renewing their 3-year commitment. We need an independent evaluator to design and conduct an outcomes evaluation and produce a report we can share with donors and MOE. Deliverable: programme evaluation report with outcomes data, methodology, and recommendations. Engagement duration: 6-8 weeks including data collection.

hire_title: Map the Service Gaps for Elderly Residents in Our Catchment Area
hire_description: We are a community service provider in Hougang with a focus on elderly residents above 65. Our funding body has asked us to conduct a needs assessment to identify gaps in current services before our next 3-year funding cycle. We need someone to design a survey methodology, coordinate data collection with our volunteers, analyse the results, and produce a report that will support our grant application. Deliverable: needs assessment report with service gap analysis and prioritised recommendations. Engagement duration: 6-10 weeks.

hire_title: Review and Improve Our Vocational Training Curriculum for Ex-Offenders
hire_description: We are a social enterprise providing vocational training and job placement for ex-offenders in Singapore. Our main courses are in F&B preparation, cleaning services, and basic IT. Our placement rate has dropped from 68% to 54% over two years and we are not sure whether the curriculum, the job market, or our placement process is the problem. We need someone to review and diagnose the issue and recommend specific improvements. Deliverable: curriculum and placement process review report with recommendations. Engagement duration: 4-6 weeks.

hire_title: Help Us Write Our Annual Impact Report for Donors
hire_description: We are a charity supporting children with learning disabilities. Our annual impact report is due in 6 weeks and our previous report writer has left. We need someone to take our programme data, case studies, and financial summary and turn them into a compelling, professionally written report suitable for sharing with donors, MOE, and NCSS. Deliverable: complete annual impact report, print-ready PDF. Engagement duration: 3-4 weeks.
